# EdiPrism — 100% Offline Enterprise Data-Format Plugins for JetBrains IDEs

> EdiPrism builds deterministic, 100% air-gapped / offline B2B data-format inspectors, semantic Ctrl+D diffs, validators, and test-fixture scrubbers for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, DataGrip, Rider, GoLand, and WebStorm (zero cloud calls, zero telemetry):
> 1. **EdiPrism X12 EDIFACT** (JetBrains Marketplace #35990: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/35990-ediprism-x12-edifact) — ASC X12 & UN/EDIFACT loop tree, semantic diff, BigDecimal balancing, 999 pinpointer, and HIPAA Safe Harbor scrubber.
> 2. **EbcdicPrism Copybook Viewer** (JetBrains Marketplace #36104: https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/36104-ebcdicprism-copybook-viewer) — Mainframe COBOL Copybook (.cpy) byte-offset calculator, multi-codepage EBCDIC & COMP-3 Packed Decimal record decoder, S0C7 validator, semantic binary diff, and offline PCI-DSS Luhn PAN scrubber.
> 3. **CanPrism DBC ARXML Viewer** (https://ediprism.github.io/can/) — Automotive & embedded CAN / CAN FD (.dbc), AUTOSAR 4.x (.arxml), and SAE J1939 64-bit Motorola/Intel bit-packing matrix, bit-overlap validator, semantic Ctrl+D diff, candump/.asc physical decoder, C99 header generator, and NDA scrubber.

- [IBM037 vs. IBM1047 EBCDIC Codepages & Signed Zoned Decimal Overpunch Table](https://ediprism.github.io/cobol/ebcdic-codepages-ibm037-ibm1047-zoned-overpunch.html): Reference table for signed EBCDIC Zoned Decimal trailing overpunch bytes ({, A-I positive 0xC0..0xC9; }, J-R negative 0xD0..0xD9) and bracket/caret swaps between IBM037, IBM1047, and IBM01140.
- [Offline PCI-DSS PAN & PII Scrubbing Inside Binary EBCDIC Test Fixtures](https://ediprism.github.io/cobol/pci-dss-binary-pan-luhn-scrubber.html): How to anonymize Primary Account Numbers (PANs), SSNs, and cardholder names directly inside binary .ebcdic mainframe files while preserving 6-digit BINs, ISO Luhn check digits, COMP-3 nibbles, and exact LRECL.
- [CanPrism DBC ARXML Viewer — 100% Offline CAN / CAN FD, J1939 & AUTOSAR Plugin for JetBrains IDEs](https://ediprism.github.io/can/): 100% air-gapped Vector CAN / CAN FD (.dbc), AUTOSAR 4.x (.arxml), and SAE J1939 inspector featuring an interactive 64-bit Motorola/Intel bit-packing matrix, bit-overlap validator, semantic Ctrl+D diff, candump/.asc trace decoder, C99 header generator, and NDA scrubber for CLion, PyCharm, RustRover, and IntelliJ IDEA.
- [Motorola Big-Endian (@0 Sawtooth) vs. Intel Little-Endian (@1) CAN Bit Numbering](https://ediprism.github.io/can/motorola-big-endian-vs-intel-little-endian-can-bit-numbering.html): Exact Vector DBC bit-numbering formulas for Intel Little-Endian (@1 LSB-start) vs. Motorola Big-Endian (@0 MSB-start sawtooth byte-boundary wrap), with worked bit-collision examples.
- [SAE J1939 29-Bit CAN Arbitration ID to PGN, Priority & Source Address Guide](https://ediprism.github.io/can/sae-j1939-29-bit-can-id-to-pgn-decoding.html): Clean-room bitwise formulas to strip Vector DBC bit-31 extended-ID flags (0x80000000) and extract SAE J1939 Priority, PDU1 vs. PDU2 PF/PS fields, 18-bit PGN, and ECU Source Address.
- [Convert AUTOSAR 4.x .arxml to Vector .dbc & Clean-Room C99 Codecs Offline](https://ediprism.github.io/can/autosar-arxml-to-dbc-and-c99-pack-unpack-codegen.html): How streaming StAX parsing resolves AUTOSAR 4.x CAN-FRAME-TRIGGERING, I-SIGNAL-I-PDU, I-SIGNAL, and COMPU-METHOD cross-references into flat .dbc files and zero-dependency C99 pack/unpack headers.
